senses: reflexive, to remind oneself of, hence, to remember

strongs.def: to bear in mind, i.e. recollect; by implication, to reward or punish
strongs.kjv: be mindful, remember, come (have) in remembrance
strongs.from: middle voice of a derivative of G3306 (μένω) or perhaps of the base of G3145 (μασσάομαι) (through the idea of fixture in the mind or of mental grasp)
